result.stderr:
Usage: AvaloniaSpy.Previewer [options]

Required:
  --project-dir <path>   Avalonia project root directory
  --axaml <path>         .axaml file to preview (absolute or relative to project-dir)
  --port <N>             TCP port for MCP connection

Optional:
  --assembly <path>      Path to compiled project DLL (auto-discovered from bin/ if omitted)
  --width <N>            Offscreen canvas width (default 1280)
  --height <N>           Offscreen canvas height (default 720)
  --theme <name>         'fluent' (default), 'simple', 'none'
  --help, -h             Show this help
